id: W:porter|oxford history of the british empire
original_title: The Oxford History of the British Empire: Volume III: The Nineteenth Century
note: Andrew Porter is the volume editor; Wm Roger Louis is the general editor under whom the collective catalogue record is indexed. Publisher confirms this volume and ISBN. No candidate matches.

id: W:bourdieu|actes de la recherche en sciences sociales
container: Actes de la recherche en sciences sociales (1980; issue and pages unspecified).
note: Journal title, not an article title. Bourdieu published several articles there in 1980, including Le capital social and L’identité et la représentation; author and year cannot distinguish them.

id: W:morris|treaties of canada with the indians of manitoba and the north west territories
original_title: The Treaties of Canada with the Indians of Manitoba and the North-West Territories: Including the Negotiations on Which They Were Based, and Other Information Relating Thereto
note: Morris’s 1880 book. ISBN and Crossref-verified book DOI identify the 2014 Cambridge reprint, whose subtitle uses “are based” instead of “were based”. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Canadian Expeditionary Force, 1914–1919: Official History of the Canadian Army in the First World War
note: Nicholson’s official history, first published in 1962. ISBN identifies the 2015 McGill-Queen’s electronic reprint with a new introduction by Mark Osborne Humphries, not the original printing. Candidate cotton article is unrelated.
George Rogers Taylor’s 1951 Rinehart book, volume 4 of The Economic History of the United States. Catalogue lists this LCCN for the original edition; no candidates supplied.

id: W:white|are you an environmentalist or do you work for a living|a
original_title: “Are You an Environmentalist or Do You Work for a Living?”: Work and Nature
container: William Cronon (ed.), Uncommon Ground: Toward Reinventing Nature (New York: W. W. Norton, 1995), pp. 171–185.
note: Richard White’s chapter, not the whole edited book. ISBN identifies the 1995 container; library contents explicitly attribute the chapter to White. Paperback container was retitled Rethinking the Human Place in Nature. No separate chapter DOI/page verified.

id: W:reis filho|ditadura militar esquerdas e sociedade
note: Publisher confirms Daniel Aarão Reis, Zahar, 1 July 2000, and ISBN. Reis Filho is the same author. Distinct from his later Ditadura e democracia no Brasil; absent from candidates.

original_title: British Preëminence in Brazil, Its Rise and Decline: A Study in European Expansion
note: The 1973 Brasiliense book is Janaína Amado’s Portuguese translation of Manchester’s 1933 English book. ISBN identifies the 1972 Octagon English reprint, not the Portuguese printing. No candidates supplied.

container: Estudos Históricos (Rio de Janeiro), vol. 2, no. 4 (1989), pp. 244–280.
note: Identification inferred from the exact pair of coauthors, journal, and year: publisher citation metadata confirms Ângela Maria de Castro Gomes and Marieta de Moraes Ferreira, 1989. Supplied title is the journal name. Article absent from candidates.

The one-word title História does not uniquely identify a work by Marcos Antonio da Silva. História: o prazer em ensino e pesquisa is plausible, but its missing subtitle cannot be recovered confidently from author and year alone.

Citation combines contributor Maria Odila Leite da Silva Dias with an incomplete editor name, Carlos Guilherme Mota. It cannot distinguish the volume 1822: dimensões from Dias’s chapter A interiorização da metrópole. Do not equate either with the 2005 collection w-324124.

container: Estudos Históricos (Rio de Janeiro), vol. 5, no. 10 (1992), pp. 200–215 (publisher metadata).
note: Journal citation metadata directly confirms Michael Pollak, title and 1992 publication. Its recorded pagination is 200–215, correcting the first pass’s 200–212. No DOI displayed; article absent from candidates.

container: Enciclopédia Einaudi, vol. 5: Anthropos–Homem (Lisboa: Imprensa Nacional–Casa da Moeda, 1985), pp. 296–332; Portuguese translation of Immaginazione sociale, Enciclopedia Einaudi, vol. 7: Imitazione–Istituzioni (Torino: Einaudi, 1979), pp. 54–92.
note: Encyclopedia entry, not the complete candidate Les imaginaires sociaux. Publisher confirms the Portuguese container and 1985 date, but displays no ISBN. No independently verifiable chapter DOI/page or container LCCN/ISBN found; entry text unread.

Livy’s Roman history in B. O. Foster’s Loeb translation, begun in 1919. Library catalogue verifies ISBN for volume I, Books I–II; it does not identify the entire fourteen-volume set. “1919-” is publication information, not the author’s lifespan. Ancient original year left unset.

original_title: Fasti Ecclesiae Scoticanae: The Succession of Ministers in the Parish Churches of Scotland, from the Reformation, A.D. 1560, to the Present Time
note: Same work under a revised subtitle: original edition 1866–1871; cited 1915 begins the revised and continued Oliver and Boyd edition. LCCN 15021137 identifies that edition and matches the cited subtitle; first-pass LCCN 10021429 identified the original. No candidates supplied.
